## What this changes

A short description of the change.

## Why

Link to the related issue (e.g. `Closes #42`) or describe the motivation if no issue exists yet.

## How to test

Steps a reviewer can follow to verify the change locally.

## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional commit message(s) — `feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`
- [ ] CI is green
- [ ] Tests added or updated where it makes sense
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or API changed
- [ ] No unrelated changes bundled in
